panels.scene: WALT stands at his workbench in the garage on an ordinary morning, tools laid out, sunlight coming through a small window, his iPhone resting face down on the bench.
panels.caption: A normal morning at the workbench.

panels.scene: Close on WALT's iPhone, screen lit but blank, sitting quietly on the workbench beside a mug of coffee. WALT's hand is just reaching for it, calm, unhurried.
panels.caption: If something looks different, we ask him.

panels.scene: WALT sits at the diner counter later that morning, newspaper open, relaxed, his iPhone back in his shirt pocket.
panels.caption: Not the family. Him, first.
